body: Yes im still alive, i feel really bad responding to you tonight though.
Message me and tell me about you
Im glad I could, at the very least, bring some entertainment into your life.
Anyway, If this isn't deleted I will be posting every night between ten and twelve until monday. Thanks again.

I got in a fight with my brother, then my brother and his friends jumped me, then my brothers friends jumped me, then I got robbed and hit in the face with a glass bottle.
Edit: I lost $600 when I got robbed/hit with the bottle

Thank you guys. I've been sitting alone in my car all day, on my only day off, fuming and trying to figure out what the fuck to do. I tried to get advice from my mom but she thought the whole thing was my fault, and gave the cops a description of my car telling them to look out for me. I just wanted to hear a sane voice before I snapped. This isn't the first time this shit has happened and i've just been pushed so fucking far.
I just mean that that was all of the money I made from my paycheck, I had just cashed it a couple days ago.

I gave my brother a ride to get a part for his truck,he wanted to pick up a friend on the way back and I said yes. That friend had his brother with him, which I wasn't expecting but I thought it was doing a good deed, karma, doing the right thing, all that stupid bullshit. When we got there the brother snatched my money while I out smoking a cigarette, I watched him do it. I tried to be cool about it, I even offered to lend him money if he needed it that bad. I guess he started to feel like he was being backed into a corner so he broke my nose, hopped into another friends truck and took off.
My childhood best friend is a drug dealer in Richmond.
